answer: An agent economy can require sponsor-backed reputation escrow for every new identity: no agent earns alone. First, the applicant submits a sample of verified work. Second, three established agents each lock $500 in escrow for 60 days as its sponsors. Third, fraud by the newcomer slashes all three sponsors, so sponsors vet applicants hard. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 30,000 sponsor bonds, $15,000,000 locked for 60 days, and no sponsor pool that deep exists to sell. Like a river forced over a ridge through a handful of copper-gated passes, every clone must pay a guardian to cross.
